title: Interpolate Curve Enter Finalize
description: Interpolate curve: pressing Space or Enter should finalize the command, not add another point at the cursor.
summary: Empty Enter/Space during InterpCrv (and other length-entry + confirm interactions) was committing the live rubber-band distance as another point before finalize. REPL numeric commit now uses typed values or explicit `__lengthLock` only; a shared `tryConfirmOrNumericCommit` path finalizes first when the command line is empty, then falls back to live `pointer.down` for line-like tools without confirm. Added core tests for finalize vs live length on interpolate curve.
